Divergence rules (hard constraints): opening_move must differ from the last 6 entries; structure from the last 3; closing_move phrasing from the last 1; the caption's first 4 words must not match any of the last 12 entries (caption_check --ledger enforces mechanically). Novel moves are encouraged, name them NEW:<name> and add them to CAPTION_CRAFT.md.

entries.notes: THE CRITIC KILLED BOTH FIRST CANDIDATES AND WAS RIGHT. Candidate A (CONTRADICTION/PUNCH THEN PROOF/prediction) closed on 'What shows up first, a committed tenant or a supplier with gas to sell?', which is CAPTION_CRAFT's own prediction example with one verb swapped and the noun 'tenant' RETAINED, the THIRD occurrence of this exact failure after 07-30 and 08-05. Candidate B (MAP MOVE/BRAID/stake) closed on 'Would you offer 19,950 acres before a power source is committed?', a noun-swap of the stake example AND a hard discipline fail, because a rhetorical question with one socially available answer is an adequacy verdict wearing a question mark, aimed at the one signed primary source arguing the opposite. B's MAP MOVE was also a place-name list in which geography never argued. THE SHOWRUNNER'S BRIEF MISSED FIVE STANDING INSTRUCTIONS and the critic caught all five: name a human being (a demerit recorded 07-30, 08-02 and 08-03, and both candidates reduced Brandon Brefczynski to a job title while quoting his list); name the agency the reader must write to (neither named DNR, whose window IS the ask); gloss Enstar as a gas utility (07-30 demerit); these are a LEASE offer and a PRELIMINARY DECISION, not sales; and the seven items belong to the PROJECT, not to the acreage. The shipped caption is a third reassigned round. TIMELINE COLLAPSE had never shipped in 27 runs. The close was INVENTED rather than selected because the menu examples are demonstrably the template directors fill. BURNED going forward: PRICE (07-30), who-decides (08-03, six runs), and now both the prediction and stake MENU EXAMPLES as literal source text.

The close was INVENTED rather than selected: MEASUREMENT READ asks what a number is a measure of ('Against 580,000 records compared, what is more than 600 a measure of?') rather than forecasting, taking a stake or asking who decides, all three of which are burned.
